news.title: Elon Musk’s Tesla Pay Package Valued at $158 Billion for 2025
news.summary: Elon Musk’s  moonshot compensation package at  Tesla  came in at $158.4 billion for 2025, according to a regulatory filing.  The pay package was part of a stratospheric compensation plan approved by shareholders last year as a way to motivate Tesla’s chief executive to spend more time at the electric-vehicle maker.  The 10-year deal could be worth $1 trillion if Musk hits every milestone, which includes growing Tesla’s market cap to $8.5 trillion.
